English: Wooden Reliquary Box
A crude, portable wooden chest for safeguarding minor relics, inspiring the faithful even on the open steppe.
Stone Chest
A sturdy stone chest for more sacred relics, lending weight to the clans faith and unity.
Guarded Shrine
A tented shrine, watched day and night by faithful guards, bolstering faith and the trust of the clans.
Chamber of Relics
A tented chamber lined with icons and relics, where clan elders gather for prayer and council.
Sanctified Room
A robust, sanctified enclosure for the holiest relics, drawing respect from all Christian nomads.
Protected Pavilion
A grand pavilion built with timber and decorated in holy motifs, a spiritual focus for the entire horde.
Priests Chamber
A permanent tent for a Christian priest, who tends the relics and counsels the clan, fostering deep unity.
Holy Hall
A semi-permanent wooden hall for worship and council, housing priceless relics and binding the faithful together.
Canopied Sanctuary
A grand mobile sanctuary of cloth and timber, with relics displayed beneath gilded canopies, inspiring awe and piety.
Grand Reliquary
A magnificent, near-permanent reliquary complex, famed among Christian nomads, uniting the clans in holy purpose.
